item.description: March 2026 was dominated by AI agent frameworks and coding assistants, with OpenClaw leading the charge as a cross-platform AI assistant gaining 20k+ stars. Notable trends include multi-agent systems, voice AI, and specialized tools for web scraping and data analysis.
